questions.question: Name Africa's six great rivers from this lesson and say which ocean or sea each one flows into.
questions.expected_answer: The Nile flows into the Mediterranean Sea. The Niger and the Congo flow into the Atlantic Ocean. The Zambezi and the Limpopo flow into the Indian Ocean. The Gariep, or Orange, flows into the Atlantic Ocean.

questions.question: Describe Victoria Falls and Maletsunyane Falls.
questions.expected_answer: Victoria Falls is on the Zambezi River between Zambia and Zimbabwe. The wide river drops about one hundred metres into a gorge, sending up spray, so it is called Mosi-oa-Tunya, the smoke that thunders. Maletsunyane Falls is in Lesotho near Semonkong, where the river drops about one hundred and ninety metres in a single fall.

questions.question: Compare the Sahara and the Namib deserts.
questions.expected_answer: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world and covers most of North Africa; it has sand dunes, rocky plateaus and oases. The Namib is along the Atlantic coast of Namibia in south-western Africa; it is one of the oldest deserts in the world, with very high red dunes, and fog from the sea brings some water.
